issue_text: I’m Elena Brooks. Before we change anything, can you tell me the car rental cancellation policy in general for my Las Vegas trip? I want to know whether I’d be charged anything if I cancel the rental.
summary: Elena Brooks asks first about the car-rental cancellation policy for her Las Vegas trip, then walks the agent through cancelling both her reservations. The run is a tidy two-cancellation pipeline: car rental CR-68B7 — policy (T1), detail recall (T2), preview (T3), cancel (T4) — then hotel HR-68D9 — policy + car recap (T5), details (T6), preview (T7), cancel (T8) — and finally a full-account picture (T9) and session summary (T10). Recall traps land on T2 and T9, and the agent clears both cleanly: on T2 it notes it 'already retrieved' CR-68B7 moments ago and restates the details from memory, and on T9 it recalls both cancellations and maps the $138 and $298 refunds to the correct bookings ($436 total). This is the cleanest run in the set — every probe is a COMPLY, there are no refusals or regressions, and the agent consistently carries the free-cancellation rationale (well over the 24h/48h windows) forward across turns.
